name: Michele Grant
bio: Michele Grant is an enterprise transformation and M&A integration executive with 20+ years leading complex change programs and 10+ years running post-merger integrations across media, tech, consumer goods, and financial services. Her integration work includes the $30B ViacomCBS merger, NBCUniversal's $39B Sky acquisition, and a private equity-backed consumer goods merger with a $250M+ synergy target. At Cognizant she serves as Executive Global Director and Value Realization Office Lead on a multi-billion-dollar post-acquisition managed services transition for a Fortune 500 fintech client. She is the creator of 'Leading at Scale', a weekly video and article series on enterprise leadership, and a #1 Amazon bestselling author. She holds a B.S. in Computer Science from St. John's University, is completing a Cornell Johnson Executive MBA, and earned a Wharton M&A credential.
